options.label: A
options.textMd: Famous authors can receive preferential treatment.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Revealing author identities would increase favoritism.

options.label: E

explanationMd: Do not manufacture a disagreement from a qualification. Sol notes imperfect anonymity while still favoring it over disclosure. Ravi's claim of necessity is compatible with a safeguard being imperfect. This item asks whether an explicit disagreement is established.

distractorRationale.c: Sol supports this, and Ravi's position is consistent with it.
